description: Which Spanish medicine records AEMPS has changed on or after a given date — new authorisations, label revisions, material-informativo updates, etc. — from CIMA's registroCambios feed. Returns nregistro, name, holder, the change date, and AEMPS's change-category tags. Useful for "what changed in the Spanish medicines register this month" or watching one drug for label updates. Example: cima_changes_since({ since: "2026-08-27" }). Keyless.

since.description: ISO date, e.g. "2026-08-27" — returns changes on or after this date.

name: cima_changes_since
title: Cima Changes Since
